title: Lesson 3.2 Coding Exercise: Functions That Return Values
prompt: Write a function add_points(score, points) that RETURNS the new score. Then call it twice, starting from 0 (add 10, then add 5), store the result each time, and print the final score. Finally, write one or two sentences explaining what return does in your program.

rubric.name: Function returns the new score (does not just print it)
Explanation accurately describes what return does in this program
